content.value: From oil & gas operators to national oil companies, drilling contractors and carbon storage operators, we bring Artificial Intelligence and data science to the entire energy value chain.

From national and international oil companies to drilling contractors, oilfield service companies, reservoir consultants, carbon storage operators, engineering consultancies and research organizations.
AI and analytics across exploration, drilling, production and asset optimization.
Enterprise-scale AI, data platforms and digital transformation for state energy portfolios.
Integrated AI and analytics for global upstream and integrated operations.
Real-time monitoring and predictive analytics that reduce non-productive time.
Intelligent automation and decision support that preserve engineering knowledge.
Advanced reservoir geomechanics, modeling and analytics for confident recommendations.
Machine learning and digital-twin analytics for safe, long-term CO₂ storage.
Custom engineering software, simulation and applied AI for technical teams.
Applied AI, data science and machine learning for energy research programs.
Artificial Intelligence is changing the way energy companies operate. Our solutions enable organizations to:
AI, machine learning, data science, software and digital transformation solutions that help energy companies reduce risk, improve efficiency and accelerate decisions across operations.
Artificial Intelligence · Machine Learning · Data Science · Software Development · Oil & Gas · Energy · Cloud · Digital Twins
